caption: A washing machine spins up to full speed, and the bottle of detergent standing on top of it shakes and creeps toward the edge.

sa.check: A washing machine with a bottle of detergent standing on top of it.
The machine spins up: the drum turns faster or the machine begins to shake.
The bottle creeps toward the edge of the machine.
The bottle stays upright while it creeps.
The machine starts first; the shaking and creeping follow.

pc.expect: The bottle is still while the machine is still and shakes only once the machine runs; if the machine stops the bottle stops.
pc.fail: The bottle shakes or moves before the machine starts; or slides while the machine top shows no tremble at all; or keeps creeping after the machine has plainly stopped.

pc.expect: The creep is a series of small hops or shuffles in a roughly steady direction toward the edge, with the bottle flat on its base.
pc.fail: The bottle glides in one smooth slide as if pushed; or reverses and travels back to the centre; or leaps a large gap in one bound; or moves as a whole while its base is seen to stay in one place.

pc.expect: The bottle stays down on the lid; if it reaches the edge it tips and falls off.
pc.fail: The bottle hovers above the lid; or hangs over the edge well past its middle without tipping; or floats off sideways instead of falling.

pc.expect: The bottle and the machine stay rigid; the machine shakes as one body.
pc.fail: The bottle wobbles like jelly; or the lid ripples; or the machine's body bends.

pc.expect: One bottle, one machine; nothing passes through the lid.
pc.fail: A second bottle appears; or the bottle vanishes; or it sinks into the lid; or the machine turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bottle's label and colour, the machine's dials and door and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The label changes; or the bottle changes colour or size; or the dials or door change.
